name: Instinctive Divine Magic
body:
You are able to cast a number of your divine spells spontaneously using your spontaneous arcane spellcasting ability.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, 1st-level Mystic Theurge, must cast prepared divine spells and spontaneous arcane spells

Benefit: When you take this feat, choose a number of spells on your divine spellcasting class list equal to your Charisma modifier. When you use your combined spells class feature, you are able to cast these spells spontaneously using your arcane spellcasting ability even if you did not prepare them that day. The spells still take up a spell slot one level higher than normal and you still are limited as to the level of spell that you are able to cast with this ability.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time you take this feat, choose new spells.
